Photocatalytic oxidation · PCO

Understanding
ductFIT technology.

UV energy, a catalyst, oxygen and moisture are the inputs in ductFIT’s described purification process. Connected IAQ monitoring adds a separate view of the conditions in your space.

From airflow to oxidation

Four stages.
One continuous process.

Inspired by oxidation in nature

Oxidation is part of natural atmospheric chemistry. ductFIT’s indoor approach uses controlled UV energy at a catalyst surface, with oxygen and water vapour present in the airflow.

What the process aims to address

The manufacturer describes action on selected odour-causing compounds and biological contaminants in air and on surfaces. Model-specific reports explain the results under their tested conditions.

An overall air quality plan

Look at the whole space.

Bring purification, monitoring, ventilation and room conditions into the same plan.

01

Understand the sources

Review activities, occupancy and the building. Use an appropriate assessment or sampling plan to understand the concern.

02

Match the equipment

Compare a standalone room unit with HVAC integration. Confirm placement, airflow, power and maintenance access for the selected model.

03

Monitor and review

Use live readings and historical trends to review conditions. Discuss follow-up IAQ testing where independent measurement is part of the project.

Questions worth asking

Know how it fits
your space.

Compare the process, installation and supporting information before selecting a model.

Discuss the technology
How does the nature analogy relate to ductFIT?

Oxidation is the shared concept. The indoor system uses a powered UV source and a catalyst, with oxygen and moisture in the air, rather than relying on sunlight.

How do the different units move air?

Standalone models use their own airflow arrangement. ductFIT Vent is installed in a suitable HVAC duct or plenum and uses the building’s airflow. Installation requirements depend on the model.

What does KleanSense add?

KleanSense provides eight environmental readings, live data and historical trends. Its dashboard helps you understand conditions and review changes over time.

How should CO₂ and humidity be addressed?

Assess fresh-air exchange and room conditions. A project may need ventilation adjustments or dedicated dehumidification alongside purification and monitoring.

What information should I request for my project?

Ask for the selected model’s data sheet, installation and care requirements, relevant test reports, and the monitoring or assessment scope included in your quotation.
